The '''Rogues' Castle''' is a building located in the deep [[Wilderness]], specifically in levels 52-56. It is one of the few places that [[rogue]]s reside in (they can be fought and [[pickpocket]]ed). An [[aggressive]] [[boss]] monster, the [[Chaos Elemental]], can be found lurking around or inside the castle. It is also part of the [[Curse of the Empty Lord]] [[miniquest]].

This area is considered to be highly dangerous, as it is in high level Wilderness which runs the risk of [[Player killing|PKers]], and has the nearby Chaos Elemental, who can bind and unequip players, cutting off possible escape routes. Additionally, there are aggressive rogues located within the castle. There is a [[Wilderness Obelisk]] nearby which can be used to escape the immediate vicinity, though it is not a surefire way to reach safety.

==Features==
Players come here mainly to kill the [[Chaos Elemental]] or to loot the three [[Chest (Rogues' Castle)|chests]] at the base of the Rogues' Castle, requiring 84 [[Thieving]] to unlock. The chest contains loot that increases with each level of the [[Wilderness Diary]] completed, as well as having a high chance to give [[hard clue]]s. When a player loots the chest, nearby level 135 [[rogue]]s will become aggressive, making it a potentially dangerous but profitable method of money-making. The chests must be searched for traps rather than opened directly--the open option will cause the player to be hit for severe damage, anywhere from 16 to 43.

The level 15 rogues are often killed to quickly complete rogue [[Slayer task]]s for [[Krystilia]].

The cape merchant [[Edward]] is located around the back of the castle by the thieving chests. He is the answer for the [[Clue scroll (master)|master clue]] anagram "DED WAR." He gives the player a puzzle box to solve in order to get the next clue.

==Monsters==
* [[Chaos Elemental]]
* [[Rogue#Level_135|Rogues (level 135)]]
* [[Rogue#Level_15|Rogues (level 15)]]
